recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If editors want to normalize the displayed label from WorkFlow to Workflow, that can be handled as a separate editorial cleanup, but FHIR-11484 itself is already applied in the current source.
issue_request: FHIR-11484 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request from the DSTU2 cycle asking that the Financial module have a hyperlink to Workflow somewhere and probably to Administration too.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found for FHIR-11484. Git history shows the request was implicitly applied in 4d97b6212a43b9561b83b29f7d66794a58c22fbe, a 2016-12-01 financial-module content update that added the sentence linking to Administration and WorkFlow/Workflow from source/financial-module.html.
additional_context: The current source/financial-module.html page is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and still contains both requested links. The target module pages exist and are titled Administration Module and Workflow Module. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision that changes the requested relationship-link treatment; broad Jira term results were unrelated scheduling/test-tracker items.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current built source already satisfies the issue by linking the Financial module introduction to both administration-module.html and workflow-module.html. The retained historical link text capitalization does not change implementer understanding of the requested related-module links, so an editorial-only source change was not made for this reconciliation.
